paragraphs: SafeStop sells a school bus tracking application that parents use to follow buses and receive notifications when a bus enters an area they have designated as an alert zone. Parents can set multiple alert zones, and the app shows the bus on a map during designated tracking windows. The pages describe a back end portal used to answer support questions from parents and to send messages about bus changes and delays.
A separate section of the site addresses transportation operators, covering data setup, daily bus re-assignments, and adjustments to bus tracking windows.

quote.text: Parents can define as many alert zones as they like and get notified as the bus approaches their student’s stop.
